title: Provenistem tracks its own development
summary: The project uses its v0.0.2 starter to maintain the standalone Provenistem branch catalog. The initial snapshot contained 10 ideas, 15 features, and two generated indexes.
acceptance_criteria: The project catalog lives on its dedicated Provenistem branch and uses the portable schemas.
Public Ubuntu and Windows jobs validate the populated project catalog and generated indexes alongside the empty starter.

evidence.claim: The first project-owned catalog is recorded at this revision.
Both public jobs passed populated catalog and empty starter validation.
